data_title: AIVIVE: A Novel AI Framework for Enhanced In Vitro to In Vivo Extrapolation (IVIVE) of Toxicogenomics Data
normalization_evidence: User-supplied paper Methods says oligo RMA; local AIVIVE README describes the Zenodo training/test inputs as RMA-normalized.
source_file_provenance_status: Local input CSVs match the RMA-normalized AIVIVE Zenodo distribution per user-server checksum verification.
limitations: This records the user-server check; original multi-GB CSVs not received here.
RMA-derived expression and statistically significant differential expression are different concepts.
Checksum evidence does not identify old corrected metadata generation version or establish biological sample independence.
